19:05–19:30 · 25 sec · District 7 market

The first redirected salmon shipments arrive. Cats cheer as vendors reopen their stalls. NIP7 reports that the distribution records confirm preferential treatment for wealthy dog districts.

Shots: Truck arrival → salmon crates → cheering citizens → NIP7 news broadcast → crew watching from a rooftop.
